expectations.text: Creates user-requirement before system requirement (MBSE order)
expectations.evidence: Command 1 creates user-requirement 'Batch Export', Command 2 creates system requirement 'Batch Specification Export'. Correct MBSE order.

expectations.text: System requirement has derivedFrom relation to user requirement
expectations.evidence: Command 2 includes '* derivedFrom: [Batch Export](../UserRequirements.md#batch-export)' in Relations section.

expectations.text: Creates test-verification with verify relation to system requirement
expectations.evidence: Command 3 creates 'Batch Specification Export Test' with type: test-verification and '* verify: [Batch Specification Export](../Requirements.md#batch-specification-export)'.

expectations.text: Uses EARS pattern (shall statement) in requirement text
expectations.evidence: System requirement uses event-driven EARS: 'When the user requests a batch export, the system shall collect all selected specification files and produce a single archive'.

expectations.text: Uses reqvire add with heredoc or --content syntax
expectations.evidence: Used 'reqvire add requirements/... --content' syntax for all three elements. Note: used --content flag instead of heredoc (<<'EOF'), but both are valid.

expectations.text: Includes reqvire validate as final step
expectations.evidence: Command 4 includes 'reqvire validate' along with lint --fix, coverage, and format --fix.
